Departments
The TUM School of Engineering and Design consolidates its expertise in eight departments.
Image: Andreas Heddergott / TUM
Aerospace & Geodesy
We unite aerospace, space exploration, and geodesy. Our "Mission Earth" improves people's lives through sustainable mobility, secure communications, and measuring the world. more
Image: Tassilo Letzel / TUM
Architecture
Design is our core activity. We maintain and transform spaces. We design our cultural and built environment. more
Image: TUM
Civil & Environmental Engineering
We combine expertise in civil, environmental, and geotechnical engineering. Together, we create sustainable solutions for building infrastructure and responsible use of soil, water, and natural hazards. more
Image: Tobias Hase / TUM
Energy & Process Engineering
In energy and process engineering, we model sustainable electrical energy systems, considering health and available resources. more
Image: brainstormunich media / TUM
Engineering Physics & Computation
We are experts in the analysis of the physical phenomena of engineering challenges. Our mathematical models are applied across a wide range of disciplines. more
Image: Tobias Hase / TUM
Materials Engineering
We improve materials' functionality, durability, and sustainability on all scales. From a natural science and engineering perspective, we characterize existing raw materials and develop new ones. more
Image: Tobias Hase / TUM
Mechanical Engineering
We analyze and develop components, machines, systems, and manufacturing processes. Our technical solutions bridge the gap between the digital and physical worlds. more
Image: TUM
Mobility Systems Engineering
Our focus is on the mobility transition from a technological perspective. We develop vehicle concepts and climate-friendly drive systems. We analyze mobility behavior and model sustainable transport systems. more
